Name: Whimsical Witch Garden-Chinese translation
Author: Skeleton0w0
Description:
[quote][b]Looking for more whimsy and magic in your Stardew game? This crop expansion adds 28 new crops, 3 mushrooms and 3 mosses that are witchy, fae, or otherwise magically inspired. Two of those crops are growable in winter, and 3 are unlocked in Year 2.[/b]

想在您的《星露谷物语》游戏中寻找更多奇思妙想和魔法？这个作物扩展模组增加了 28 种新作物、3 种新的蘑菇和 3 种新的苔藓，它们的设计来源于巫术、仙灵或其他魔法风格的要素。这些作物中有 2 种作物可以在冬季种植，并且有3 种需要在 2 年才能解锁。

——Whimsical Witch Garden 模组介绍[/quote]

[b]本模组仅为翻译文件，请配合本体[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31119]Whimsical Witch Garden[/url]使用。[/b]
将zh.json文件下载并放入模组本体i18n文件夹即可。
